scenario.summary: China-based AI companies such as DeepSeek and Alibaba are conducting industrial-scale knowledge distillation against U.S. frontier AI models to extract proprietary capabilities. They utilize fraudulent accounts, 'transfer stations' (API proxies), and multi-hop infrastructure to bypass regional restrictions and exfiltrate billions of tokens via high-volume API requests.

meta.rationale: Use the identify-account-clusters step to find the specific API gateways and source IPs under pressure. Narrow subsequent queries using the scope_hosts parameter to reduce noise.
meta.hypothesis: China-based AI companies are using fraudulent account clusters and 'transfer station' proxies to conduct high-volume extraction of proprietary model capabilities through API gateways.

scope_hosts.description: API Gateways or reporting proxies identified in the scoping step to focus the hunt.

lookback_days.description: Days of history to examine for throughput and account clustering.

proxy_domains.description: Known domains for API transfer stations.

user_threshold.description: Number of unique accounts per IP that triggers suspicion of a proxy.

references.name: CISA AA26-251A: China-Based AI Companies Conducting Industrial-Scale Distillation Campaigns

blind_spots.risk: We rely on volume and account density as proxies for intent. Highly efficient legitimate automation might be misclassified.
blind_spots.question: Are the prompts using 'chain-of-thought' or 'jailbreak' techniques specifically?
blind_spots.remediation: Implement sampled logging of prompt metadata (length, presence of specific system-prompt bypass keywords).

blind_spots.risk: Static IP blocks are less effective if the transfer stations rotate IPs faster than the hunt cycle.
blind_spots.question: Are the source IPs belonging to short-lived cloud instances?
blind_spots.requires: Real-time IP threat intelligence for cloud egress points
blind_spots.remediation: Integrate cloud provider IP feeds to automatically tag ingress traffic from AWS/Azure/GCP regions.

hunt.name: Industrial-Scale AI Model Distillation
hunt.description: This hunt identifies systematic model distillation by detecting clusters of accounts originating from shared infrastructure (transfer stations), resolving known distillation proxies like z.ai, and exhibiting industrial-scale request volumes. We pivot from identity-layer anomalies—multiple accounts per source IP—to network-layer exfiltration patterns observed at the API gateways, as recommended in CISA Advisory AA26-251A.

config.beyond_detection: A single rule could flag 'z.ai', but this hunt correlates identity-layer account clustering on shared IPs with network-layer exfiltration volume and behavioral fingerprints (User-Agents) across multiple gateways to distinguish a campaign from background noise.

config.content: SELECT dst_endpoint_name, src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) AS unique_accounts, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status_id = 1 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY dst_endpoint_name, src_endpoint_ip HAVING unique_accounts >= {{user_threshold}} ORDER BY unique_accounts DESC
config.description: Locate API gateways experiencing abnormal account density from single source IPs, indicating possible 'transfer station' usage.
config.expected_signal: Source IPs (transfer stations) used by dozens or hundreds of accounts to access a specific gateway. Large unique_accounts values confirm aggregation.

primitive_config.label: Identify Account Clusters on Proxies
primitive_config.content: SELECT dst_endpoint_name, src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) AS unique_accounts, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status_id = 1 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY dst_endpoint_name, src_endpoint_ip HAVING unique_accounts >= {{user_threshold}} ORDER BY unique_accounts DESC
primitive_config.expected: Source IPs (transfer stations) used by dozens or hundreds of accounts to access a specific gateway. Large unique_accounts values confirm aggregation.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) AS lookup_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{proxy_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(query_hostname) LIKE '%.z.ai') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname
config.description: Identify gateways resolving known 'transfer station' domains while focusing on the scoped API gateways.
config.expected_signal: Gateways resolving z.ai or other transfer stations confirm the routing pathway described in the research.

primitive_config.label: DNS to Distillation Proxies
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) AS lookup_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{proxy_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(query_hostname) LIKE '%.z.ai') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname
primitive_config.expected: Gateways resolving z.ai or other transfer stations confirm the routing pathway described in the research.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name, COUNT(*) AS request_count, SUM(response_bytes) AS total_bytes FROM hb_http_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name HAVING request_count > 10000 ORDER BY request_count DESC
config.description: Quantify exfiltration volume per account and source IP at the scoped gateways.
config.expected_signal: Accounts with millions of requests (distillation) versus thousands (legitimate usage).

primitive_config.label: Industrial-Scale Request Throughput
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name, COUNT(*) AS request_count, SUM(response_bytes) AS total_bytes FROM hb_http_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, src_endpoint_ip, actor_user_name HAVING request_count > 10000 ORDER BY request_count DESC
primitive_config.expected: Accounts with millions of requests (distillation) versus thousands (legitimate usage).

config.content: SELECT user_agent, src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) AS accounts, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM hb_http_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY user_agent, src_endpoint_ip HAVING accounts > 5 ORDER BY accounts DESC
config.description: Identify uniform automation patterns across many accounts on a single IP, suggesting scripted distillation.
config.expected_signal: Multiple accounts sharing the same User-Agent and source IP indicate a coordinated bot fleet rather than individual human users.

primitive_config.label: Coordinated User-Agent Fingerprints
primitive_config.content: SELECT user_agent, src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) AS accounts, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM hb_http_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY user_agent, src_endpoint_ip HAVING accounts > 5 ORDER BY accounts DESC
primitive_config.expected: Multiple accounts sharing the same User-Agent and source IP indicate a coordinated bot fleet rather than individual human users.

config.objective: Determine if the account clusters, proxy IP associations, and volume throughput indicate a coordinated industrial-scale distillation campaign targeting model functionality.
config.description: Evaluate account density, proxy resolution, and request volume to confirm a coordinated distillation campaign.
config.expected_signal: A verdict per account cluster/IP identifying malicious distillation.
config.success_criteria: A verdict of 'malicious' for clusters showing >50 accounts/IP and high-volume requests, or 'benign' for legitimate bulk users.

config.question: The triage verdict is malicious for at least one account cluster or source IP.
config.condition: The triage verdict is malicious for at least one account cluster or source IP.
config.description: Route based on the certainty of the distillation findings.
Immediately disrupt the distillation by revoking tokens and blocking 'transfer station' IPs.
config.instructions: Revoke OAuth sessions for the identified account clusters. Block the source IPs of 'transfer stations' at the API gateway or firewall level.

config.description: Review findings and coordinate with legal/policy for long-term remediation.
config.instructions: Validate the cluster activity against billing data and coordinate with legal teams regarding terms of use violations. Share transfer station IPs and User-Agents with industry peers.
Document false positives from legitimate high-volume enterprise users to tune future runs.
